evidence: Task packet requires routed units/current pages/citation candidates to be gathered into an immutable context pack and commit validation to enforce policy, budgets, and generations (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-14-maestro-brain-agency-context-os-implementation-plan.md:2533-2539).

maintainBrainPage is declared as FunctionSpec.publicMutation with only workspaceSlug/input args and no caller/principal/brain/page tenant identifiers (packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.spec.ts:5-20).

maintainBrainPage impl ignores args and returns Effect.succeed canned data without loading or validating tenant-owned workspace/brain/page context (packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.impl.ts:7-17).

Task packet requires administrator-controlled progressive autonomy and administrator-only Autopilot graduation (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-14-maestro-brain-agency-context-os-implementation-plan.md:2483-2485,2537-2539).

maintainBrainPage is a public mutation and its implementation has no auth/role check before accepting the request (packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.spec.ts:15-20; packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.impl.ts:7-17).

The UI model hides Autopilot controls for viewer/editor roles, but this is client-side only and not backed by a server-side admin/owner authorization boundary in the capability (apps/web/src/features/brain/maintenance-review.tsx:80-99).
Maintenance context includes lifecycleGeneration and lifecycleState, with requireActiveLifecycle throwing LifecycleRevoked when revoked (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/policy.ts:37-53,69-75).
gatherMaintenanceContextPack calls requireActiveLifecycle before returning a bounded context pack (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/gather.ts:7-16).
Focused tests cover lifecycle-revoked gather inputs (packages/convex/test/brain-maintenance.test.ts:135-153).

Task packet requires exact routed evidence/citation candidates and prompt-injection controls, with customer/provider/model values treated as untrusted data (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-14-maestro-brain-agency-context-os-implementation-plan.md:2533-2539; requirement AI-04 at lines 201-202).

maintainBrainPage exposes a public mutation accepting arbitrary input as Schema.String and its generic domain normalizes raw input without enforcing immutable context-pack-only citations or redaction boundaries (packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.spec.ts:5-20; packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.domain.ts:4-30).

The implementation returns a canned success rather than proving that no raw user/provider text can be submitted to or persisted by the public capability path (packages/convex/confect/capabilities/maintainBrainPage.impl.ts:7-17).

Task packet requires one accepted revision effect, duplicate attempts coverage, and stale page/source/route/lifecycle generation failures (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-14-maestro-brain-agency-context-os-implementation-plan.md:2527-2532,2564-2566).

commitMaintenanceProposal is a pure function that returns a revisionEffect but does not perform an atomic durable compare-and-set/write against brainMaintenanceProposals or page revisions, so concurrent reviewers/autopilot workers could each accept the same logical proposal in real wiring (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/commit.ts:39-77).
brainMaintenanceProposals defines indexes but no unique constraint/effect-key field for one accepted revision effect (packages/convex/confect/tables/brainMaintenanceProposals.ts:18-38).
Task packet requires duplicate attempts and one accepted revision effect proof (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-14-maestro-brain-agency-context-os-implementation-plan.md:2531-2532,2564-2566).

proposalKeyFor is derived only from pageKey, currentRevisionKey, output kind, and modelPromptPair, excluding route/lifecycle/policy generations, citations, content hash, and explicit effect/idempotency keys (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/request.ts:44-55).

The commit path has no durable accepted-effect check or replay record; it returns published/accepted_noop every time the same proposal is passed with fresh context (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/commit.ts:39-77).
Maintenance proposals carry expectedRevisionKey, routeGeneration, lifecycleGeneration, and policyGeneration (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/request.ts:24-42,67-78).

commitMaintenanceProposal checks current revision, route generation, lifecycle generation, and policy generation against the proposal and throws StaleRevision on mismatch before returning a revision effect (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/commit.ts:25-37,47-49).
Focused tests assert stale currentRevisionKey is rejected (packages/convex/test/brain-maintenance.test.ts:79-98).

No changed maintenance/capability/workflow files import live provider SDKs; semantic model output is represented as typed MaintenanceModelOutput input to the deterministic request/commit functions (packages/convex/confect/maintenance/request.ts:9-22,57-95).

The workflow impl composes Convex workflow component functions and local workflow ownership/status helpers rather than calling provider adapters directly (packages/convex/confect/workflowContracts/sourceToBrainMaintenance.impl.ts:1-35,145-228).

Lane proof records check:provider-boundary-equivalent gates for workflow/layer/headless surfaces and the passed pre-review lane gate for S08-T04 (ci-proof-packet.json:32-42; lane gate output reports S08-T04 passed pre-review).

findings.summary: Public maintainBrainPage capability lacks server-side tenant, auth, and privacy boundary.
findings.details: The task contract is for a workflow-scoped cited Brain maintenance capability over immutable routed context. The added Confect spec is a public mutation with workspaceSlug/input only, and the implementation accepts by returning canned success without resolving an authorized caller, workspace membership, brain/page tenancy, admin Autopilot authority, or context-pack-only/redacted inputs. This creates a public server path that does not enforce tenant isolation or authorization before accepting maintenance requests.

findings.summary: Maintenance commit/replay path lacks durable atomic one-effect fencing.
findings.details: The task requires duplicate-attempt handling and exactly one accepted revision effect. The commit helper only performs in-memory freshness checks and returns a revisionEffect; it does not atomically persist acceptance, compare-and-set the proposal/page revision, or record an effect key. The proposal key also omits generations, citations, content hash, and idempotency/effect key fields, so stale or distinct attempts can collide while replayed fresh attempts can repeatedly publish in real wiring.
